title: `generatorRef` under `.data[].sourceRef` is not implemented — from 0.9.9 it fails the whole ExternalSecret

detection.reason: read from the agent's projection of each ExternalSecret's data[].sourceRef.generatorRef kind (kind only, never the remote key)

remediation: Move every generator reference from `spec.data[].sourceRef.generatorRef` to `spec.dataFrom[].sourceRef.generatorRef` on the ExternalSecrets named. Before 0.9.9 such an entry silently read from the object's default store; from 0.9.9 it resolves a store named "" and the whole ExternalSecret errors (SecretStore "" not found). The field is still accepted, and still ignored, in the v1 API.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.data // .spec.externalSecretSpec.data // [])[] | select(.sourceRef.generatorRef != null) | . as $d | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) generator=\($d.sourceRef.generatorRef.kind)"'  # each row is a .data[] entry that still points at a generator
coversNotes: API v1beta1 externalsecret_types.go GeneratorRef: Deprecated: The generatorRef is not implemented in .data[].

title: ClusterExternalSecret `namespaceSelector` is deprecated in favour of `namespaceSelectors`
remediation: Move `spec.namespaceSelector` to a one-element `spec.namespaceSelectors` list on each ClusterExternalSecret named. The singular field still works in 2.14; upstream says it will be removed in a future release.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.namespaceSelector != null) | .metadata.name'  # each name still sets the deprecated singular selector

title: Fake provider `valueMap` is deprecated (removed in 0.16)

detection.reason: the fake provider's data[] entries are not in the store projection beyond their key names

quote: Deprecated: ValueMap is deprecated and is intended to be removed in the future, use the `value` field instead.
remediation: Replace `valueMap` with `value` (a JSON string) in each fake store's `data[]` entry. 0.16 removes `valueMap` (rtz-external-secrets-0.16-fake-provider-valuemap-removed).
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("fake")) | select(any(.spec.provider.fake.data[]?; has("valueMap"))) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a fake store still using valueMap
coversNotes: v0.9.10 (What's Changed): feat(fake): deprecate ValueMap to use Value instead

title: Azure Key Vault: AAD Pod Identity authentication is deprecated — use Workload Identity

detection.reason: which Azure identity a ManagedIdentity store resolves through (AAD Pod Identity or Workload Identity) is decided outside the store spec

quote: Since the AAD Pod Identity is deprecated, it is recommended to use the Workload Identity authentication.
remediation: For each Azure Key Vault store named with `authType: ManagedIdentity` that relies on AAD Pod Identity (an AzureIdentity/AzureIdentityBinding), move it to `authType: WorkloadIdentity` with a federated service account. AAD Pod Identity itself is archived upstream.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("azurekv")) | select(.spec.provider.azurekv.authType == "ManagedIdentity") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is an Azure store that may depend on AAD Pod Identity

title: IBM Cloud Secrets Manager: the deprecated fetch-secret-by-name code path is removed

detection.reason: the remote key of an ExternalSecret is never collected

quote: IBM provider: remove deprecated code for fetching secret by name
remediation: For each IBM store named, check that every ExternalSecret using it references secrets the way the 0.9.12 IBM provider docs describe (secret type prefix + ID or name with secret group); a name-only key that resolved through the removed code path now fails with "secret group name is missing" and stops syncing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("ibm")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is an IBM store whose ExternalSecrets should be re-checked

title: Helm chart: `prometheus.*` values removed — metrics scraping set through them stops
remediation: If the release set `prometheus.enabled` / `prometheus.service.*` (or the webhook / certController copies), move them to the top-level `serviceMonitor.*` and `metrics.service.*` values before upgrading — Helm ignores the old keys silently and the metrics Service / ServiceMonitor is no longer rendered.
verifyCommand: helm list -A -o json | jq -r '.[] | select(.chart | startswith("external-secrets-")) | "\(.namespace)/\(.name) \(.chart)"'  # each row is an ESO Helm release; run helm get values on it and look for prometheus
coversNotes: v0.9.10 (What's Changed): Remove references to Prometheus in Helm chart
